modules.name: Announcements Auditor
modules.description: Find scheduled Canvas announcements whose fire dates are stale (typically after a course copy keeps last term's dates) and recreate them with corrected dates. Read-first; creation is confirm-gated; never deletes anything.

companions.name: Canvas Backup
companions.summary: Downloads a complete local archive of a Canvas course.
companions.whyYouWantIt: Canvas Toolchain reads a Canvas Backup archive as the starting point of the course-refresh pipeline. It also works entirely on its own as a backup tool.
